Marlin, Nemo, and the reef they have to leave.

How Clownfish family connects

  • Character: Marlin — Marlin is the father of the clownfish family.
  • Character: Nemo — Nemo is the son the ocean takes.
  • Character: Dory — Dory joins Marlin and Nemo as family.
  • Work: Finding Nemo — The clownfish family is the household Finding Nemo starts from.

What is Clownfish family?

The clownfish family is the tiny anemone household Finding Nemo starts from: a cautious father, a taken son, and the ocean in between.

Key threads lead to Marlin, Nemo, Dory and Finding Nemo.
